verdict.rationale: Moss publishes a structured API reference: a v1 overview that documents the `/v1/manage` action-multiplexed endpoint and operations like `createWebSource`, plus per-class SDK reference pages such as MossClient. There is no evidence that this reference is interactive or has in-page runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no spec to drive a try-it console. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
